description: How the analyst asked for outliers to be identified.

mode.description: Use 'absolute' when the analyst names a KPI threshold, e.g. 'outliers below 3.0' or 'anything above 3.2'. Use 'baseline' when they ask for outliers without naming a number, meaning each machine should be compared against its own normal level.
mode.title: Mode

limit_value.description: The KPI threshold named by the analyst, used only when mode is 'absolute'. If no number was named, use 3.0.
limit_value.title: Limit Value

direction.description: Which side of the limit to mark, used only when mode is 'absolute'. 'below' for under/below/less than/worse than, 'above' for over/above/more than/better than. Default 'below'.
direction.title: Direction

threshold_unit.description: Unit for a numeric threshold: use 'percent' for a relative deviation, otherwise use 'absolute' for the OPO KPI value.
threshold_unit.title: Threshold Unit

baseline_deviation_pct.description: Percentage deviation above a machine's own median that counts as abnormal, used only when mode is 'baseline'. Return null when the analyst did not specify it.
baseline_deviation_pct.title: Baseline Deviation Pct

interpretation.description: One short sentence stating how the request was read, including which rule was applied, so the analyst can check it.
interpretation.title: Interpretation

lookback_days.description: Number of most recent days to include, default 14.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

machine_id.description: Machine or exposure equipment ID filter, if named.
machine_id.title: Machine Id

exposure_equipment_id.description: Exposure equipment ID filter, if named.
exposure_equipment_id.title: Exposure Equipment Id

suggested_limit_value.description: Only when the analyst did not name an explicit numeric threshold: an absolute OPO KPI outlier cutoff recommended from the supplied empirical P95/P99 context. Prefer P95 for a broader screening threshold or P99 for severe anomalies. Null when the analyst already named a number.
suggested_limit_value.title: Suggested Limit Value

suggested_limit_rationale.description: One short explanation for suggested_limit_value, grounded only in the supplied P95/P99 values. Null when suggested_limit_value is null.
suggested_limit_rationale.title: Suggested Limit Rationale

title: DetectionScope
